chants.notes: Printed incipit: 'Gaudeamus omnes in Domino... sub honore sanctorum omnium'. gregobase only catalogs this melody as ellipsis-form disambiguators shared across feasts (Reginae, Thomae, Assumptione...). gr_index_entry's curated 'Gaudeamus Sanctorum omnium' is All Saints' correct disambiguator -> id 752 (Solesmes); used verbatim here.

Engraving continues onto p620 (jubilus + full verse 'Venite ad me omnes qui laboratis, et onerati estis: et ego reficiam vos'); band here only crops this page's portion (mode label + opening) since the index row (page 619) anchors identity.
GR p620 prints 'Ps. 125*, 1. 2 ab. 2 cd. 3. 4. 5. 6 ab. 6 cd' in its own block immediately below this citation (y 296.4-317.7) - a psalm-tone plan, not a chant, not a target page, not modeled.
